tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders should abide by all other terms and conditions as per the tender document attached
The authority reserves the right to accept or reject of any tender without giving any reason

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Total Years of Experience in the field of Various Health Services (Determined from the year of incorporation). Firms less than three years experience considered.

The Tenderer should have successfully provided Various Health services to any Central/State Govt./Semi Govt./ Private/ during the last three Financial Years (i.e Financial Years 2025-26, 2024-2025 and 2023-2024) Preceding the last date for submission of Tenders should have provided the service to 400 bedded Govt. Hospital/ Private / Medical College Hospital/ Other Organisation proceeding last 3 years.

The Tenderer should have on their name minimum Two work at present as on the last date of submission of tender. A self attested certificate in the letter head of the Tenderer is required to be submitted by the Tenderer.

The Tenderer should have a minimum Net worth of Rs 1,47,50,000/- as at the end of the most recent financial year preceding the last date for submission of Tenders (i.e. Financial Year 2025-26) Below Twice net worth will Not be considered.

The Tenderer should have minimum Average Annual Turn over of Rs. 2,95,00,000/- from the last three completed financial Years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders (i.e. Financial Year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26)
The Tenderer should have credit facility of not less than (Rs.1,00,00,000) of credit line or letters of credit from the banks meeting the fund requirement. (Estimated cash flow for 3 months)
